name: Nanniang Lian'ai Wuyu
source:
Conquer Your Femboy Roommate! You are Li Fei, a college freshman. On your first day of school, you have a chance encounter with an unbelievably beautiful person at the stadium. Later, when you return to your dorm room, you discover that this stunning beauty is actually your roommate—a boy, and a sweet, soft, femboy!

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3715730/_/]Steam[/url]]
